Built for your field

An assistant we build for your work, then hand over. Per engagement, priced before it starts.

Start an engagement

Launch prices. They may change before launch; anyone on the waiting list hears first.

What "included" means.

A meter, not a mystery

The app shows how much of this month's included use is left, and warns you at 80 %. A monthly statement lists each model and its cost.

Then your credit

Past it, use comes from your prepaid credit. Every receipt names the model and what it cost.

Budgets slow first

A budget you set slows the assistant down before it stops it. Nothing is charged to a card you did not top up.

The cheapest model that works

Your assistant sends each step to the cheapest model that passes its check. You can pin a model in settings.

Building on it?

In the app you pay one rate and the assistant picks the model; in the router you pick the model and pay its list price.

Developer pricing

Questions about money.

Do you take a cut of what I book or earn?

No. There is no platform fee on a booking, a payment between people, or what a business earns.

How is use priced in the app?

Each step goes to the cheapest model that can do it, and the receipt shows the model and the cost. Seats include everyday use; past it, use comes from your credit.

What is the 5 % top-up fee?

Adding credit costs 5 % on top, shown before you pay. Credit lasts 12 months.

Who needs a seat?

In a team, only people who hold a budget. Everyone else joins free.
